title: Core orchestrator struct + agent-direct mode
description:
Implement core orchestrator package and agent-direct placement mode per docs/plans/21-serve-orchestrator.md §3.1-3.6, §6 Bead 1.

Required reading: docs/plans/21-serve-orchestrator.md

Key deliverables:
- internal/orchestrator/orchestrator.go — Orchestrator struct, constructor, Close/Shutdown, lifecycle context
- internal/orchestrator/session.go — sessionEntry, PlacementMode types, session registry (add/get/remove/list)
- internal/orchestrator/proxy.go — Full AgentService implementation: CreateSession with agent-direct routing, all proxy methods (SendMessage, Continue, Steer, FollowUp, Abort, SubscribeEvents, DestroySession, GetSession, ListSessions, ResumeSession), sessionIDRewritingReceiver for stream proxying
- internal/orchestrator/config.go — OrchestratorConfig, validation, placementFromMetadata()
- cmd/flexagent/serve_orchestrator.go — Replace placeholder with full CLI wiring (flags, config construction, HTTP server, signal handling)
- Unit tests with mock SandboxControl and mock AgentService covering: placement routing, session ID translation, response rewrite, proxy delegation, stream event fidelity, destroy ordering, compensation cleanup, max sessions, close semantics

Why agent-direct first: simplest mode (no sandbox-host, no in-process loop), exercises full CreateSession -> proxy -> DestroySession lifecycle.
